summary: Produces developer INTEGRATION RECIPES for the Learnosity Author API and item bank (Data API): a precise, host-language-neutral procedure — goal, preconditions, steps, gotchas, and acceptance criteria — for embedding the Learnosity item editor and for creating, updating, fetching, listing, and tagging items in the item bank. It emits a recipe to follow, NOT Learnosity item content and NOT runnable code.
in_scope: How to embed the Learnosity Author API item editor in a host/LMS app (signed init request, allowed widget types, user identity)
How to correctly sign a Learnosity request (the HMAC signature preimage, field order, timestamp format, domain match)
How to save (create) an authored item into the Learnosity item bank via the Data API
How to update an existing item bank item
How to fetch a single item's definition from the item bank
How to list/search item bank items with filters
How to tag items and attach item metadata (standards, DOK, difficulty) so the Author Site can index them
The acceptance criteria that tell the developer their integration is correct (what 'done' looks like)
out_of_scope: Authoring the assessment item CONTENT itself (stems, options, answer keys, passages) — that is L0176; this dialect describes how to INTEGRATE, it does not write items
Delivering/administering assessments to learners (Items API init, sessions, embed lifecycle, SSO) — that is the delivery integration dialect (L0178)
Reading responses, scores, mastery, or building reports/analytics — that is the analytics integration dialect (L0179)
Integrations for any platform other than Learnosity
Emitting runnable host-language code — the recipe is a language-neutral procedure the caller implements in their own stack
